name: nextdoor-social-mcp
description: Nextdoor (social): me, publish_text, publish_image, delete. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

platform_mcp_nextdoor_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEXTDOOR_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_nextdoor_access_token.description: Publish API user access token: apply for access (Nextdoor Partnerships issue client_id / client_secret), send the user through https://www.nextdoor.com/v3/authorize/ with scopes openid post:write post:read comment:write profile:read, then exchange the code at POST https://auth.nextdoor.com/v2/token (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/sharing-get-access-token; expires_in 31536000 s in the documented example). Refresh it before expiry (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/sharing-refresh-access-token). Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'.

platform_mcp_nextdoor_secure_profile_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEXTDOOR_SECURE_PROFILE_ID
platform_mcp_nextdoor_secure_profile_id.description: Optional profile id from GET /me/profiles (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/me-copy) to post / delete as a business or other profile of the account instead of the default neighbor profile.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /external/api/partner/v1/me/ (profile:read) returns {id, first_name, last_name, status, verified, is_business_profile, neighborhood_name, city_name, business_name, ...}.

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: PUBLISHES a post to the user's Nextdoor neighborhood (or to the business / entity page of config secure_profile_id): POST /post/create/ {body_text (max 8,192 characters)} (post:write) answers {result: 'success', share_link: 'https://nextdoor.com/p/{post_share_id}'}. The API returns no separate id, so `id` and `url` are both the share_link (its last path segment is the post_share_id). `reply_to` is ignored.

tools.name: publish_image
tools.description: PUBLISHES a post with media_attachments = image_urls ('The limit is 10 attachments'; every URL must be valid and publicly accessible). body_text is REQUIRED by Nextdoor, so pass `text` (a post without it is rejected with 400). `id` / `url` are the returned share_link.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: DELETE /post/?id= 'Deletes your post on Nextdoor that matches the post id provided' (post:write) and answers {message: 'Post deleted successfully'}. `post_id` is the post id as listed by GET /post/ (Get your posts, https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/get-your-posts).
